experiment: AGQ-only: standard GPTQ vs AGQ-GPTQ on identical C4 Random B=128 windows
question: Does router-affinity-weighted Hessian accumulation improve MoE quantization quality over standard GPTQ under a strong matched natural-text calibration baseline?
rtn_fallback: none expected (all experts have tokens at B=128); any fallback is recorded and invalidates nothing but is reported

calibration.extension_rule: run s1 and s2 if FR_s0 AGQ is valid (correctness + resources), regardless of the direction of the s0 result

conditions.C4R128_GPTQ: historical CANONICAL-B1 GPTQ result (weights sha256 in calibration_manifest); admissible only if the unit_regression stage reproduces it bitwise with the modified code (hessian_weighting='none')

agq.hessian: H_e = sum_i c_{i,e} x_i x_i^T via (sqrt(c) x); c not c^2
agq.normalization: none added: production GPTQ uses the raw sum and percdamp * mean(diag H) damping, both invariant to a global positive scale
agq.applied_to: all routed gate_proj/up_proj/down_proj of layers 1/8/16/23; shared expert and router untouched

evaluation.standard_expert_recon: E3 per-expert held-out relative reconstruction (unchanged); config = mean of 240
evaluation.weighted_expert_recon: sum_i c_i ||E(x_i)-Ê(x_i)||^2 / sum_i c_i ||E(x_i)||^2 over ALL routed held-out tokens with held-out routing coefficients; config = mean of 240
evaluation.moe_layer_output: PRIMARY: per layer sum_x ||y_BF16 - y_quant||^2 / sum_x ||y_BF16||^2 over all 65,536 held-out tokens, fp32 math, frozen BF16 routing (identical inputs, router and c), shared expert included in y; config = mean of the 4 layer values
evaluation.moe_layer_output_native: secondary: same ratio from the actual BF16 Qwen2MoeSparseMoeBlock forward with installed weights
evaluation.exposure_deciles: deciles of natural routing frequency p (runs_low_budget/routing_profile_v2.npz)

decision_rule.AGQ_LAYER_QUALITY_GAIN: mean rel diff <= -tau AND >= 3/4 layers improved AND every measured seed improves
decision_rule.AGQ_SURROGATE_ONLY_GAIN: not the above AND weighted expert recon rel diff <= -tau
decision_rule.AGQ_RUN_BLOCKED: any correctness gate fails (alignment, oracle, unit regression, validity)
decision_rule.robustness: a gain is called robust only if every measured seed agrees; one seed is never robust

secondary.ppl_noise_source: largest calibration-grouping |dPPL| in update_batch_sensitivity.md / |dPPL| scale in update_ebss_official_validation.md
